build_gym_data: build gym data by running all task scripts in parallel with configurable process count
verify_data_integrity: verify data files against pre-computed MD5 checksums to ensure consistency
process_task_scripts: process a list of Python task scripts sequentially and track failures
compute_file_md5: compute the MD5 hash digest of a given file for verification
parse_cli_args: parse command line arguments for build mode, verify mode, and task configuration
